_about: Scene presets for scripts/render_photos.py. Every asset is CC0 from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), downloaded once by scripts/fetch_assets.py. 'hdri' lights the scene and shows (blurred) behind the model; 'surface' is the tabletop texture. Add a scene by picking an indoor HDRI and a texture id from polyhaven.com and giving it a name here.

studio.use_for: product shots: seamless sweep, soft key light, fill and rim

desk.use_for: desk accessories, organizers, office and gaming gear

counter.use_for: kitchen and bathroom items, holders, dispensers

cafe.use_for: cups, coasters, table games, seasonal pieces

workshop.use_for: tools, tool holders, functional and mechanical parts

loft.use_for: modern or minimal pieces, lamps, geometric designs
